items.label: Exploration cubes — 7 rewards per dungeon
items.hint: Reward cubes are capped per dungeon — swap dungeons before rerunning favorites. Unclaimed cubes roll over up to 10.

items.label: Conquest cubes — 1 per 8 h
items.hint: The reward-count cap is 21/week even though the timer allows more.

items.label: Odyle Energy — spend before Wednesday
items.hint: Exploration cubes cost 20–30, Conquest cubes 40. Accrues +120/day worth — cap it before reset.

items.label: Sanctuary attempts — 4 per raid
items.hint: Attempts are consumed on ENTRY, not on kill — don't queue unless the group is committed.

items.label: Transcendence dungeons
items.hint: Entry: Lv 45 + 2,200 GS. Primary Arcana card farm.

items.label: Ascension Trial
items.hint: Feeds the PvE Daevanion board currency (Substance Morph).

items.label: Daily Dungeon — Daeva Bio-Research Base
items.hint: Enhance-stone source. Server-wide pool, not per character.

items.label: Duty missions (~250k Bound Kinah + ~1,000 AP each)
items.hint: Community conflict: one source reads 5/day per SERVER — verify on your server.

items.label: Abyss entry — accumulated time
items.hint: Oct 14 patch: entry is a capped accumulated currency now.

items.label: Abyss Sieges (Mon / Thu / Sat 12:00 UTC)
items.hint: ~45,000 AP bursts — the week's biggest AP paydays.

items.label: 10v10 Battlefields
items.hint: Feeds the PvP Daevanion board (Azphel) currency — Monolith feathers.

items.label: Stigma Shards — Abyss Trade Shop (Growth tab)
items.hint: The Lv 45 power gate — dump surplus AP here after siege weeks.

items.label: Abyss Entry Stones — from Abyss weeklies
items.hint: Season Missions moved to the Abyss tab and now pay entry stones (Oct 14 patch).

items.label: Trick or Treat login (35 coins + day-7/14 bonuses)
items.hint: Missing a day costs 35 coins — 620 total needs perfect attendance.

items.label: Candy Keys — 60 fragments → 1 key
items.hint: Blue candy is the best value. Server-wide cap — don't over-farm fragments.

items.label: Sealed Wings → Substance Morph
items.hint: Oct 6/7 patch cap — coordinate with legionmates.

resetNote: Weekly caps reset Wednesday 07:00 UTC on all Global servers (16:00 in-game server time). The checklist below auto-clears at that moment.
